# PR #4928: Patch: a dungeon fight that a Glitch voided is dealt again, not reported as a lost fight that ends the whole run

Closes #4852

## What changed

When a Glitch voids a dungeon fight (`GameOverReason::Voided`, R679), the run no longer counts it as a loss. The run stays on that fight with its HP unchanged, and the fight screen offers **Deal it again**, which deals the same fight fresh from its seed. Before this, a void at full health ended the run with "Dead at 0 HP".

- **`crates/run/src/fight.rs`**: The fold now lives in a crate-private `fight_report`, which returns the game's end reason along with the `FightOver`. The public `run_fight_report` calls it and refuses a void with the error `VOIDED_FIGHT`. The shared host's `on_run_report` already turns an `Err` into `RunReport::Refused`, and `save()` already clears the kept fight once the game is over, so `crates/shared` is unchanged.
- **`crates/run/src/assault/attempt.rs`**: `assault_fight_report` calls `fight_report` directly, so the Infinite Assault behaves exactly as before: a void is still a lost fight. A comment says the Assault's own ruling belongs to #4576.
- **`apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`**: For a voided fight the screen asks the worker for no report and holds or sends nothing to the run. The result panel shows a status note ("A Glitch voided this fight, so it never happened. Your run stands where it was."), a primary **Deal it again** button and Main menu.
  - Deal it again reuses `onRetryFight`, which fully restarts the fight from its seed, as R2972000's Try again does.
  - Main menu only navigates, because there is no report to send.
  - Coming back to the run later deals the fight fresh, because the host keeps no save of a finished game.
  - Also changed: `testids.ts` (`voided`, `redeal`) and `zh-CN.json` (two entries).
- **Spec**:
  - §15.6 now reads "Any other end but a void drops HP to zero and ends the run", followed by a sentence that a voided fight never happened and is dealt again from the same seed.
  - New ruling `spec/rulings/R4852000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4852.md`.

# #4852: Patch: a dungeon fight that a Glitch voided is dealt again, not reported as a lost fight that ends the whole run
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

In a dungeon run, a fight that a Glitch voids ends the whole run as if the fight had been lost.

Glitch's fourth outcome ends the game with `Winner::Draw` and reason `Voided` (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/glitch.rs:66`). The practice host's `on_run_report` (`crates/shared/src/host/practice/host.rs:740-760`) checks only `is_run()` and `is_over()`, and `is_over` is documented as "voided or not" (`host.rs:358`). `run_fight_report` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:278-282`) then reads:

```rust
Ok(RunAction::FightOver {
    won: outcome.winner == Winner::from(human),
```

so a void becomes `FightOver { won: false, .. }`. `run_reduce` takes that at `crates/run/src/lib.rs:1926-1933`: HP to 0, `RunPhase::Dead`.

In the test the human is at full health (20 of 20) on turn 2 when the enemy's Glitch voids the game, and the run ends dead.

The same host treats this ending as nothing everywhere else: `end_of_game` (`host.rs:495-497`) emits `Voided` and returns before any record ("the one ending that records nothing"), a practice claim is refused (`ClaimRefusal::Voided`), and the web's controller still sets the phase to "over", so the fight screen asks for the report.

It is rare: a real fight meets a Glitch only after a "… in the System" card is played (Classic #18 or #25, both in the run's pool), at 1 in 10,000 for each generated card (R673), then 1 in 4 for the void. When it happens, a whole run is lost to no fight result.

### What should happen

- SPEC §2.5's table of endings: "A Glitch voids the match | No result: the match never happened (R679)".
- `crates/run/README.md`: `run_fight_report` refuses "a game with no result".
- The precedent for a mode of several games: `docs/implicit-states.md` row A13, a voided Conquest game, "The series plays the same game again", pinned by `r679_a_voided_conquest_game_never_happened_the_series_plays_the_same_game_again`.

So a voided fight should not be reported as a loss; the run should stay on its fight and deal it again.

**The one text against this reading**, stated plainly: §15.6 says "Any other end drops HP to zero and ends the run." Read literally it covers a void, and it is deliberate for real draws (the turn cap, both heroes dead, the enemy fleeing). Neither §15, `docs/dungeon-run.md` nor any run ruling (R2706000, R3476000, R3584000, R4733000 and the rest) mentions a void or a Glitch, so this is a decision the spec does not make.

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `a_fight_a_glitch_voided_is_not_reported_as_a_lost_fight`, in [`crates/run/tests/audit_run.rs` at e0cdb51](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/e0cdb51/crates/run/tests/audit_run.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`). Run with `cargo test -p jackioh-run --features jackioh-engine/testkit --test audit_run`.

The test builds the fold input a fight's report reads: two small Training Grounds decks under a fight's two handicaps (the human P1 at 20, the enemy P2 at 10), both opening hands kept, P1's first turn ended, then P2 plays a Glitch, on the first seed whose Glitch draws the void (asserted: `(Winner::Draw, GameOverReason::Voided)`). The game is a sandbox only so the test can put the Glitch in P2's hand; a run's fight is never a sandbox. It then asserts `run_fight_report(&game, PlayerId::P1).is_err()` and, for the failure message, feeds the report it got to `run_reduce`.

Output today:

```
a voided fight has no result (§2.5, R679), yet it reports Ok(FightOver { won: false, hp: 20, damage_dealt: 0, healing_done: 0, cards_drawn: 1, turns: 2 }), and the run is then Some("Dead at 0 HP")
```

### Where

The dungeon run and its host: `crates/run/src/fight.rs` (`run_fight_report`), `crates/shared/src/host/practice/host.rs` (`on_run_report`), and the fight screen in `apps/web/src/dungeon/`.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Have `run_fight_report` refuse a result whose reason is `Voided`, and have the fight screen deal the fight again from its seed instead of showing "could not be read". The host already clears the kept fight when a game has a result, so a fresh deal follows.
- **It takes a ruling note** in this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3), with SPEC §15.6 amended in the same pull request: either "a voided fight never happened: it is dealt again" (suggested, matching R679 and the Conquest precedent) or "a void is an 'other end'", in which case the code stays and the README's "refuses a game with no result" is corrected instead.
- Deal it again from the same fight seed, or from a fresh one? The same seed replays the same game up to the Glitch, which the player could then avoid; say which in the ruling.
- `assault_fight_report` reads results the same way; the Infinite Assault is in progress (#4576) and was not audited, so leave a note there rather than changing it here.
- No test pins a voided run fight. The one void test for practice (`r679_r768_a_voided_game_shows_its_result_leaves_no_last_board_and_is_kept_nowhere`) pins "kept nowhere" for a free game.
- The same audit found the rest of the run sound: 60,000 seeds through `run_create` with an independent map checker; every action in every phase read against §15.2 to §15.10; 45 whole runs on the real catalog with all 627 fights played to the end, every `run_fight_report` matching the live game's winner, health and turn.
- A related design question the audit left alone because §15.6 answers it explicitly: when the enemy AI flees (S #148.1), the human's result is a draw "not a loss … everywhere a seat's result is read" (R1843004), yet the run ends exactly as on a loss.
